system.description:
Battle Amp

While in this state, you gain the following benefits;

Rabid. You gain a +2 bonus to your AC and Dexterity saving throws.

Ferocious. You increase damage you deal by +1 damage die. If multiple damage die of different sizes are rolled, add one additional die of the largest size.

Hunting. You are always s aware of the location of creatures with less than full hit points so long as they are within 60 feet of you.

Calming. You exit Feral at the end of your next turn.
system.summary: +2 AC and Dexterity saves, +1 damage die, and you sense wounded creatures within 60 feet. Ends at the end of your next turn.

rules.text: Starts when you or your Nin-Dog score a critical hit.
Below half HP: Feral for 1 minute, ignoring Calming (once per rest).
Ferocious: +1 damage die (the largest size) on your damage.
